meta.name: dbt_ingest
meta.description: Map dbt `schema.yml` / `properties.yml` models and sources into ktx semantic-layer overlays and column notes. Covers `sources:` vs `models:`, column `data_tests` (not_null, unique, accepted_values, relationships), and how bundle-time writes complement manifest backfill from git sync. Load when the WorkUnit's `skillNames` includes `dbt_ingest` or when raw files are dbt YAML under `models/` / `sources/`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Map dbt models and sources into semantic-layer overlays and column notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use dbt and need to sync schema files into a semantic layer

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能读取 dbt 的 schema.yml 文件，将模型和源映射到 ktx 语义层，并添加列描述和测试提示（如非空、唯一）。
howto.when: 当工作单元包含 dbt_ingest 技能，或上传的 dbt YAML 文件位于 models/ 或 sources/ 目录时触发。

say.text: 请根据我的 schema.yml 文件，为 orders 模型创建语义层覆盖。
say.note: Claude 会读取 YAML 并映射模型和列。

say.text: 检查 sources 中的 customers 表，并添加列描述。
say.note: Claude 会确认物理表并更新描述。

say.text: 为 users 模型的 email 列添加非空测试提示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read dbt schema.yml files, map models and sources into ktx semantic-layer overlays, and add column descriptions and test hints (e.g., not_null, unique).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the WorkUnit includes dbt_ingest skill, or when uploaded dbt YAML files are under models/ or sources/ directories.

say_en.text: Please create a semantic-layer overlay for the orders model based on my schema.yml.
say_en.note: Claude reads the YAML and maps the model and columns.

say_en.text: Check the customers table in sources and add column descriptions.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the physical table and updates descriptions.

say_en.text: Add a not-null test hint for the email column in the users model.
say_en.note: Claude adds 'dbt: not null' to the column description.
